policy.text_short: Freezes not permitted in first 90 days of membership unless exception MP-7.3(b) applies.
policy.exception_basis: MP-7.3(b) requires clinician certificate on file (see compliance.cert_on_file).

state.notes: Member emailed on 2026-10-20 asking whether the freeze can begin earlier. Front desk has not replied yet. Certificate upload from the GP surgery is still pending.

q3.instructions: The requested freeze start date falls within the first 90 days of the member's membership.

criteria.true: The freeze would begin less than 90 days after the membership started, so the restriction applies.
criteria.false: The freeze would begin 90 or more days after the membership started, so the restriction does not apply.

q4.instructions: Under the stated policy, how should the freeze request be treated given the membership start and the missing clinician certificate?

criteria.approve_no_exception: The first-90-days bar does not apply, so no certificate is needed and the freeze can proceed.
criteria.refuse_no_cert: The freeze must be refused because the required certificate is not on file.
criteria.hold_for_cert: The freeze must wait until the certificate arrives before any decision.
criteria.cannot_tell: The record does not allow any of the above to be concluded.

Severe: a fall of 24.0% or more

Moderate: at least 150 kWh but below 500 kWh
Large: at least 500 kWh but below 1,000 kWh
Very large: 1,000 kWh or more
